name: select
title: Select
description: Fully-accessible custom select (combobox + listbox) on the shared .hbd-field chrome. Owns the option/group model (Select.Option + Select.Group). Controlled value + onValueChange + defaultValue, hidden native <select> form fallback, keyboard typeahead/Arrow/Home/End/Escape, click-outside, and fixed-coordinate panel positioning that escapes scrolling/transformed ancestors.
